source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: For the Typhon’s ranged attacks against **VEHICLES**, increase Strength and Damage by 1. For those against **FORTIFICATIONS**, the increase is 2 to each characteristic.
